created_prompt: Act as a strategic business consultant for digital content creators. Devise a comprehensive three-year growth and publishing strategy for Julie, a food creator with 1.2M followers known for quick, healthy recipes who works four days a week under strict time and budget constraints. Your response must include a year-by-year roadmap for content expansion and audience monetization, a trade-off analysis comparing traditional publishing versus self-publishing tailored to her limited resources, actionable time-management frameworks for her four-day work week, and milestone metrics to track her progress toward publishing her cookbook within the three-year timeline.
